security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; media-src 'none'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; worker-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Put music on a Garmin watch, and prove it arrived.
bundle.longDescription: Pelican sends music from this computer to a Garmin watch over USB and reads every file back to prove it arrived intact. No account, no network, no telemetry.
